subject: Darryl McCauley
query: what happened to dane cook brother
title: What happened to Dane Cook's brother? The $12 million theft
answer: Dane Cook's half-brother and business manager, Darryl McCauley, stole at least $12 million from the comedian between 2004 and 2008. He and his wife, Erika, pleaded guilty in 2010 to theft, embezzlement and forgery. McCauley was sentenced to six years in prison and ordered to repay Cook, but after his release he disappeared without paying the money back.
body:
The theft is the subject of the documentary "Funny Money: The Dane Cook Story," which reaches Netflix in the U.S. on Nov. 6, 2026. Directed and written by Brett Harvey and narrated by Cook, it first premiered on Sept. 18 at the Aero Theatre in Los Angeles and went to digital stores on Sept. 29. It was commissioned by Canada's Super Channel under the title "Brace for Impact." It is a licensed film, not a Netflix original.

The money vanished while Cook was one of the best-selling comedians of the 2000s. McCauley pulled out sums of $20,000, $50,000 and up to $100,000 at a time without Cook noticing, and hid cash in a safe and even wrapped in plastic inside pasta sauce containers. The scheme came to light after Cook hired a new business manager. Erika McCauley received two to three years. Cook believes the true loss may be higher than $12 million.

As boys, both brothers wanted to be stand-up comics; McCauley became a corrections officer instead. Cook has called him "the devil that was my brother" and says he spent about a decade in therapy rebuilding his life.
in_the_news: "Funny Money: The Dane Cook Story," about the theft by his half-brother, arrives on Netflix in the U.S. on Nov. 6, 2026.

faq.a: No. He was sentenced to six years and has since been released; reports say he disappeared afterward without repaying Cook.
